meta.title: Correct code and a new password log the user in and end the other sessions
meta.requirement: AC5 — reset with code logs in, signs out other sessions
precondition: QA-VERIFIED user with a second (API) session
steps: Read the code from the API log, type it, new password, submit
API: log in with the old, then the new password
API: refresh with the second session's refresh token
expected: Event password_reset_done and the app lands on Profile signed in as the user — event log + UI tree
Old password → 401, new password → 200 — API response
The other session's refresh token is refused (401) — API response

done: 2. Type the code and the new password
